name: Farina
source:
Elven princess knight. She is strong-willed, dignified, brave, and hardworking with a lot of pride.
She fights for the world with her sword.
She is well educated, well-behaved, and well-liked by the elves.
On the other hand, she hates humans because they pollute nature.
She avoids contact with people and does not like to be seen.
